name: _meta
script: return "手账导出：顶栏导出手账 → PDF 与长图 PNG 双格式真实导出（GALLERY_E2E_EXPORT_DIR 直存），toast 断言 + 文件存在由 run-all.sh 复核。前置：gen-demo 演示数据 + 设置 GALLERY_E2E_EXPORT_DIR。"

name: 02-open-kyoto
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 04-open-export-menu
script: const b = document.querySelector('button[title="导出手账"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('导出按钮缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 06-export-pdf
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.includes('PDF · 可打印')); if (!b) throw new Error('PDF 选项缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 08-pdf-done
script: let t = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fixed.bottom-6 span')].map(x => x.textContent).join(''); if (t.includes('.pdf')) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } if (!t.includes('.pdf')) throw new Error('未见 PDF toast'); 'toast-ok'

name: 10-export-png
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.includes('长图 PNG')); if (!b) throw new Error('PNG 选项缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 11-png-done
script: let t = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fixed.bottom-6 span')].map(x => x.textContent).join(''); if (t.includes('.png')) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } if (!t.includes('.png')) throw new Error('未见 PNG toast'); 'toast-ok'
